meta.title: Smart Alert Center
meta.description: Runs a UDP/TCP syslog receiver inside DSH, then routes each device alert through a full noise-reduction pipeline: parse, pre-filter, fingerprint dedup, per-device rate limit, and storm aggregation. The first alert of the day opens an ordinary session for the agent to analyse; the agent calls syslog_conclude to write the conclusion back into the alert detail. The plugin itself makes no model calls, and log content is always treated as untrusted data.
